name: onnxruntime-c
description: A pod for the ONNX Runtime C/C++ library.
prepare_command:
set -e
# The NuGet package holds every platform; keep the iOS xcframework as published,
# its headers where source_files expects them, and the licence files.
unzip -q runtimes/ios/native/onnxruntime.xcframework.zip
mkdir -p Headers
cp onnxruntime.xcframework/ios-arm64/onnxruntime.framework/Headers/*.h Headers/
find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name onnxruntime.xcframework ! -name Headers ! -name LICENSE ! -name ThirdPartyNotices.txt -exec rm -rf {} +
